note:
⛔ SNG-489. TWO SCHOOLS OF BODY. Erik: 'Traversal can be ABSORBED BY THE OTHER 2.'
⚠️ AND IT SPLITS EXACTLY ALONG THE SECT LINE, which is why I had it as its own school and should have read it as evidence instead: LOOSE-LIMBED and SKYDANCER are somatic — the trained body going over and out, which is DISCIPLINE. NEAR WAY and RAISED ROAD are mason — knowing how built things open and where stone will hold, which is MATERIAL.
⛔ THE 'EVENLY SPLIT SCHOOL' I DEFENDED WAS TWO HALVES OF THE OTHER TWO SCHOOLS SITTING NEXT TO EACH OTHER. A destination is not a craft; how you reach it is.

Material._what: ⛔ WHAT A THING IS AND WHAT IT WILL DO — read it, mend it, throw it, take it apart, and move through it. ⚠️ AND THE SAME CRAFT TURNED ON PEOPLE: what your word is worth, what a job costs, and what is left of someone reduced to what can be weighed.
Material._absorbed: ⛔ ABSORBS STANDING AND THE MASON HALF OF TRAVERSAL. All three social crafts price something — a word, a job, a person — and the concrete pole does not distinguish. ⚠️ AND NEAR WAY AND RAISED ROAD ARE MATERIAL KNOWLEDGE USED TO MOVE: the mason finds the seam that is already in the wall, or stands on stone that arrives because they know where it will hold.
Material._note: ⚠️ Nine mason and one somatic — Hurled Weight, a person USING matter rather than reading it.

Discipline._what: ⛔ THE BODY AS THE INSTRUMENT — conditioned until it stops taking harm the way bodies do, trained until it acts before the decision, carried past what ground allows, and finally drawn on directly as force.
Discipline._absorbed: ⛔ ABSORBS CLOSE WORK AND THE SOMATIC HALF OF TRAVERSAL. Conditioning and contact-work were never two things — Perfect Motion is training that lands as a strike, Answered Motion is a strike that is really training. ⚠️ AND LOOSE-LIMBED AND SKYDANCER ARE THE SAME TRAINING POINTED AT DISTANCE: running past what a body should, slipping a grip, stepping on nothing. ⛔ KI WIELD IS THE END OF ALL OF IT — the trained body spending itself as force.
Discipline._note: ⚠️ All somatic. The tradition's identity, its obscure, and its capstone.

_balance._why2: ⛔ TWO SCHOOLS, AND THEY ARE THE SECTS. Material is nine mason plus Hurled Weight, Near Way and Raised Road; Discipline is ten somatic. ⚠️ FOR BODY THE SCHOOL AND THE SECT COINCIDE — which is NOT true of Mind, where Suggestion crossed cogitant and figurist. ⛔ THAT IS ITSELF THE FINDING: Body's two peoples do not share methods. A mason and a somatic reach the same rooftop by unrelated crafts.
